items.details: In button-only mode, deliberate right-stick movements control sword direction; pressing the right stick performs a thrust. Let it return toward neutral between cuts so repeated inputs do not become an unintended Spin Attack. Hold L while moving the right stick when you want the camera instead. With the sword out and shield equipped, click the left stick just before impact for a Shield Bash; a correctly timed parry avoids normal shield wear. Motion mode uses the corresponding Joy-Con movements, so practice the mode you actually selected.

details_i18n.pt: No modo por botões, movimentos deliberados do analógico direito controlam a direção da espada; apertar o analógico executa uma estocada. Com espada e escudo equipados, aperte o analógico esquerdo antes do impacto para um Shield Bash; uma defesa precisa evita o desgaste comum do escudo. O modo por movimento usa os Joy-Con, então pratique o modo escolhido.

If an eye closes, adjust your distance or height before repeating the circles.

If he catches the sword, recover it before continuing the same exchange. In the armed phase, read the direction of his guard and cut through the opening; a Shield Bash can interrupt his rush. Move away from projectiles when the pattern is unclear, then re-enter for a short controlled attack rather than spending stamina on random spins.

items.details: Treat the large stone ball as a moving platform you steer by walking on its surface. Use short corrections and look ahead before committing to a narrow lava channel. Bombs reveal cracked walls and can be rolled into low openings that an ordinary throw misses. When a mechanism seems unreachable, inspect it from the ball's height and check whether a nearby wall hides another passage. Return to stable footing before planning a new bomb throw; losing your orientation on the ball is more dangerous than taking a moment to reset.

items.details: A Timeshift Stone changes only its active area, so observe where working machinery meets present-day ruins. Before deactivating a stone, check whether you are standing on a platform that disappears or inside an energized hazard that becomes safe. The Hook Beetle lets you interact from a distance and carry Bomb Flowers to otherwise inaccessible targets. In the generator routes, hidden stone paths remain physically present beneath quicksand, and the map can help you follow them. Move between safe sections deliberately rather than sprinting across an uncertain patch of sand.

items.details: The island's center pedestal rotates the bridge segments, while the crystal changes which barriers stop their movement. Inspect the three segments after each small adjustment and use a raised barrier to hold one segment while another catches up. The goal is a continuous bridge, not simply turning the pedestal until a sound plays. If you have already moved the puzzle, follow the visible positions rather than copying a move count intended for its untouched state. Cross the aligned bridge and use a Skyward Strike on the emblem inside.

details_i18n.pt: O pedestal central gira os segmentos da ponte, enquanto o cristal muda as barreiras que interrompem o movimento. Examine os três segmentos após cada ajuste e use uma barreira levantada para segurar um enquanto outro se aproxima. O objetivo é formar uma ponte contínua, não apenas girar até ouvir um som. Se já alterou o mecanismo, siga as posições visíveis em vez de copiar uma contagem feita para o estado inicial. Atravesse a ponte alinhada e use um Skyward Strike no símbolo interno.

items.details: Keep the opening duel controlled: defend the sword strikes with well-timed Shield Bashes and punish briefly instead of trading long combos. When the storm phase begins, ordinary skyward charging is replaced by catching lightning. Raise the sword during a safe lightning opportunity, release the charged strike to stun Demise and close in for damage. Evade his own charged attack instead of assuming a normal shield block stops it. When he falls, act promptly on the finishing opportunity; a missed attempt means surviving another exchange, not an automatic victory.
